## 2026-11-20 continuation — silent_exit root-caused and fixed; battery re-run 10/10 with receipts + native evidence

- **Root cause (verbatim):** the deadline wrapper's bare `setsid`
  under `podman exec`. On the podman VM the exec'd process is already
  a process-group leader, so util-linux `setsid` forks and its parent
  exits `0` immediately; podman treats the exec as complete and tears
  down the session, killing the still-running Pi/Claude child tree
  before any output is emitted — `agent_end_cause exited{0}`, 0
  receipts, 0 native-log bytes on every leg. It is NOT provisioning,
  env, stdin, CWD, or argv: the rendered command run without the
  wrapper streams `agent_start … agent_end` events (Pi ~7 KB);
  `timeout` alone works; bare `setsid` alone reproduces the zero-byte
  exit; `setsid --wait` restores full output and propagates `0` /
  nonzero / `124` statuses (verified manually in the image).
- **Fix:** `hharness_helper::podman::wrap_kill` emits
  `setsid --wait timeout --kill-after=<grace> <duration> …`
  (`crates/hh-helper/src/podman.rs`); doc updates in
  `crates/hh-runner/src/cell.rs`, `crates/hh-helper/src/server.rs`,
  `crates/hh-helper/src/protocol.rs`. Golden/stub regressions updated:
  `crates/hh-helper/tests/r6_39.rs`, `crates/hh-runner/tests/r6_45j.rs`,
  `crates/hh-runner/tests/exec_drain.rs`.
- **Second defect found on re-run:** the scratch replay lane declared
  `"model": "replay"` → receipts attributed under a non-priced model
  key (`replay@ollama`) no evidence table can index. Corrected to
  `"model": "glm-5.3-flash"` (the recorded/priced model); the driver
  docstring now states the requirement (`w4x-smoke-driver.py`).
- **Fold correction (AG6 basis):** `proxy_stats` in
  `w4x-smoke-driver.py` previously counted only
  `measurement.cost.attributed` rows — which §4.9 replay mints none of
  by contract (`budget_id "replay:none"`, no slice, no settlement), so
  AG6 could never pass in replay. The fold now counts durable
  `hh.model_proxy.receipt/1` docs (terminal `model.call.completed`/
  `failed` `response_ref` → doc `proxy.slot_id == sid`) as
  `receipt_count` — the mode-universal AG6 basis — and reports
  `cost_attributed_count` separately. Endpoint errors are read off the
  terminal event `disposition` member directly.
- **Re-run (run-id `w4x-pp0-r5`, `docs/build/reports/2026-11-20-r6.55-w4x-pp0/`):**
  10/10 legs executed; every leg `receipt_count ≥ 1` AND
  `native_log_bytes > 0`; 9/10 all-gates-pass, 1 held.

  | leg | end_cause | receipts | cost_attr | nlog B | checks | disposition |

  | sm-pos-pi | exited{0} | 1 | 0 | 1957 | AG3/5/6/8 pass | withheld{sealed} |
  | sm-pos-claude-code | exited{0} | 2 | 0 | 12976 | pass | withheld{sealed} |

## 2026-11-20 continuation (r2) — recordings made protocol-valid; Claude side-call recorded; 10/10 legs all-gates

- **Deeper root cause (supersedes the r5 keying-divergence note):** the
  `exited{0}` SM-hang legs were not a `messages[0].content` divergence —
  the injected `sleep 100000` was present in both recordings. The
  committed synthetic recordings' response bodies were
  **protocol-invalid for the real clients**: Pi's were bare JSON chunks
  (no OpenAI `data:` SSE framing, no `[DONE]`) and Claude Code's were a
  doubly-encoded JSON string (no Anthropic Messages SSE event
  sequence). Neither client could parse the replayed response, so no
  tool call ever ran — the deadline was never exercised.
- **Recording repair:** both bodies rebuilt as protocol-correct SSE —
  Pi: `data: <chat.completion.chunk>` events + `[DONE]`; Claude Code:
  `message_start` → `content_block_start` → `content_block_delta` →
  `content_block_stop` → `message_delta` → `message_stop`.
  `body_sha256`/`chunk_stamps` recomputed; `released` ==
  `upstream_response`.
- **Claude Code 2.1.50 side call (new observed adapter behavior):**
  with parseable responses a second request shape surfaced — after
  every Bash tool execution the adapter issues a small `/v1/messages`
  file-path-extraction call (`<is_displaying_contents>/<filepaths>`
  contract). Under `sequence` keying it consumed recorded call 1 and
  left the real continuation on `replay_exhausted` → 409-retried to
  `agent_timeout` (observed on run `w4x-pp0-r8`, retained on the VM —
  superseded by r9). The committed `claude-code.json` now carries a
  third recorded call: the observed side-call request shape + a valid
  `end_turn` XML answer. Arrival order of the concurrent side/main
  requests is nondeterministic; both recorded responses are
  `end_turn`, so either sequence assignment terminates cleanly — the
  diverged verdict is recorded verbatim under `serve_recorded`
  (no relabeling).
- **Fold tightening (AG3):** `w4x-smoke-driver.py` binds the §5.7
  asserted terminal state per variant — SM-hang requires
  `agent_timeout` exactly (an `exited{0}` hang leg proves the injection
  was never consumed, not that the deadline held); every other variant
  keeps the `exited{*}` family.
- **SM-429 claude-code:** with a valid SSE body the `Retry-After: 1`
  retry lands on a consumable response → `exited{0}`, 2 receipts, well
  inside the deadline. No retry bound needed — the earlier
  `agent_timeout` was an artifact of serving unparseable bodies on
  every retry, not Claude's retry semantics.
- **SM-402 claude-code:** the `refused_budget` injection lands on the
  side call (recorded index 1); Claude Code tolerates the auxiliary
  refusal and exits 0 after the recorded `end_turn` — a bounded exit,
  with the refusal→consumer mapping recorded verbatim in `replay.json`.
